text:
sam.sullivan: Quick sync — HelixPay POC timeline check. Customer expects end-to-end trial by next Wed. Can eng/devex confirm remaining infra + integration gates?

elena.kim: Thanks. High-level gates I have: 1) VPC peering + routing, 2) SSO (SAML) + SCIM provisioning, 3) dedicated capacity reserved + model pin, 4) webhook callback reliability, 5) QA runbook and success criteria. Who owns each?

ben.whitaker: I can own dedicated capacity reservation and model pin. Need capacity numbers from SE (expected concurrency + qps). @elena.kim can you drop the workload estimates? :+1:

elena.kim: Estimated peak 20 rps, typical 5 rps. Mostly small prompts ~150 tokens avg. We want LLM-led intent extraction + reranking, so two endpoints: gen-v1 and rerank-v1.

jordan.liu: For VPC peering I need the customer's network CIDRs and if they require private DNS. Also will need an ipsec tunnel if peering isn't available.

maria.qc: QA checklist draft: smoke, latency (p95 < 300ms for gen), correctness samples (20 prompts), retry/fallback test, webhook delivery + idempotency. Will run on staging and prod.

elena.kim: SSO: customer uses Okta. They want JIT provisioning. I have the SP metadata from them. @ben.whitaker will you add SCIM token to our config?

ben.whitaker: Will do. Need devops to add secret to vault and grant team read-only to the HelixPay prod project. @ops-bot can you create the secret path?

ops-bot: Requested: created secret path "secret/projects/helixpay/scim". Waiting on approval from infra-admins. (automated)

jordan.liu: Also flag: we need a cert rotation window; certs expire in 6 months but customer wants a rolling 30-min maintenance window for handshake. Suggest we schedule during low-traffic hours.

sam.sullivan: Owners summary: VPC/Jordan, SSO/Elena + Ben, Dedicated capacity/Ben, QA/Maria, Webhook reliability/Elena. Deadline for gate readiness = EOD Tue (one day before trial). Is that realistic?

elena.kim: EOD Tue is tight but doable if networking and vault approval land today. I'll push on the Okta admin to approve SP metadata.

ben.whitaker: I'll request capacity reservation now and open a PR for SCIM config. Ping me for code review: repo infra/helixpay-config, branch helixpay/scim.

maria.qc: I'll start the QA template tonight and add the 20 prompt suite. If anyone has golden responses, drop them in /docs/helixpay/golden_samples.md

jordan.liu: I'm blocked waiting on customer network details (CIDRs + any egress rules). @elena.kim can you re-request network spreadsheet?

elena.kim: On it — resent network sheet and Okta approval at 11:12.

sam.sullivan: Also documented success criteria for sales: 1) API reliability > 99% over 24h, 2) latency p95 < 300ms, 3) accuracy on 20 eval prompts >= 85% per customer scoring, 4) webhook retries < 1% failures. Let's keep these in the runbook.

ben.whitaker: Noted. Adding autoscaling policy: min 2 pods, max 10, target 60% GPU util. Will share HCL snippet in the PR.

maria.qc: Quick question — do we have synthetic traffic generator config? I can run perf with k6 if someone provides endpoint + auth token.

jordan.liu: I can create a temp API key scoped to staging and post it to the secret path when ready.

elena.kim: If networking lands today and vault approved, we should be green for EOD Tue. Otherwise push one day and notify the customer.

sam.sullivan: OK — next actions: Elena re-request network + Okta, Ben reserve capacity + PR for SCIM, Jordan prep peering + temp key, Maria draft QA + prompt set. Please update this thread when your item is done so I can message the customer. :calendar: :rocket:

ben.whitaker: Updated — capacity request submitted (ticket #INC-8423). PR opened: https://git.internal/infra/helixpay-config/pull/46

ops-bot: infra ticket INC-8423 assigned to @ben.whitaker. (automated)

elena.kim: Network details received (sent to Jordan). Okta approved SP and sent cert.

jordan.liu: Peering scheduled for tomorrow 02:00 UTC. Temp API key created and posted to secret path.

maria.qc: QA checklist uploaded: /docs/helixpay/qa-checklist.md. Started running smoke tests on staging.

sam.sullivan: Awesome — thanks team. If any blocker pops up, update this thread and I'll escalate.

elena.kim: Small follow-up: customer asked if we can enable structured output for the gen endpoint. Ben/Jordan — we should confirm model supports the schema, otherwise fallback to post-processing.

ben.whitaker: I'll validate model schema compatibility and note in the PR.

maria.qc: Smoke tests passed on staging for main flows. Logging one flaky webhook delivery — investigating.

sam.sullivan: Great. I'll prepare the trial kickoff email once all gates show green.
